Echeveria eurychlamys (Diels) A.Berger, 1930
黑夜，由Berger发表于1930年Synonym: Cotyledon eurychlamys Diels (1906)
异名：Cotyledon eurychlamys Diels (1906)Distribution: Peru (Cajamarca : Hualgayoc, Celendín, Chota).
分布于秘鲁卡哈马卡省的Hualgayoc, Celendín和Chota地区。Description (according to IHSP, 2003):
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem usually < 10 cm tall, 5 – 10 mm in diameter.
茎部：通常不高于10cm，5-10mm直径。Rosette 7 – 9 cm in diameter.
莲座：7-9cm直径。Leaves obovate-oblong, 3,5 – 6 x 1,5 – 3 cm, mucronate, greyish-green, often red-tipped.
叶：倒卵形-椭圆形，3.5-6cm长，1.5-3cm宽，有短尖，灰绿色，常有红尖。Inflorescences : Erect straight racemes to 25 cm; bracts semi-orbicular, fleshy, 10 – 15 x 6 – 12 mm, pedicels stout, 2 – 3 mm long.
花序：直立的总状花序，可达25cm；苞叶半圆形，肉质，10-15mm长，6-12mm宽；花梗粗壮，2-3mm长。Flowers: Sepals ascending, fleshy; corolla to 14 – 16 x 6 – 8 mm in diameter, coral- red.
花：萼片上向，肉质；花冠14-16mm长，6-9mm直径，珊瑚红。Cytology : n = ± 80
染色体：n=±80
Description (according to G. Pino, Haseltonia 15, 2009) :
描述（根据发表于2009年的Haseltonia 15中G. Pino的说法）：Roots fibrous.
须根。Stem not growing above ground.
地上没有明显的茎部。Rosette up to 15 cm in diameter.
莲座直径可达15cm。Leaves 26 – 38, 6 – 8 cm long, 2 – 4 cm wide, 3 – 4 mm thick, widely obovate-oblong, light green to glaucous white, margins hyaline.
叶子26-38片，6-8cm长，2-4cm宽，3-4mm厚，宽阔的倒卵形-椭圆形，浅绿色或灰绿色，叶缘透明。Inflorescence an equilateral raceme with 8 – 16 flowers, nodding at first, then erect, up to 30 cm long, bracts numerous,1.6 – 2.6 x 0.6 – 1.7 cm, obovate to orbicular, spurred at base, pedicels 2 – 6 mm long.
总状花序，上有8-16朵花，顶部下折，底部竖直，可达30cm长；苞叶众多，1.6-2.6cm长，0.6-1.7cm宽，倒卵形到圆形，底部有小刺；花梗2-6mm长。Flowers : Sepals erect, ovate-deltoid, 5 – 7 mm long, light green-glaucous, corolla ovoid, 6 – 7 mm thick near base, petals 1.1 – 1.2 cm long, outside yellow to pink at base, salmon to pink towards apex, inside salmon-yellow, tips recurving.
花萼竖直，卵形-三角形，5-7mm长，淡绿色-灰绿色；花冠卵形，基部6-7mm直径；花瓣1.1-1.2cm长，外部的基部黄色到粉色，顶部橙红色到粉色，内部橙红色-黄色，顶部反折。
Note :
请注意：Plants in nature show only slight variation.
自然界中的植株没有太大个体差异。Plants in cultivation differ strongly from plants in nature.
园艺中的植株与其自然栖息地上的状态大相径庭。This species is unique for its almost orbicular bracts.
这个品种较大的特点是其近乎于圆形的苞叶。
